actions.description: Create a meeting registrant in Zoom.
actions.name: create-meeting-registrant

meeting_id.description: The meeting ID or meeting number. Example: "85746065"

occurrence_ids.description: Occurrence IDs. You can find these with the meeting get API. Multiple values separated by comma.

email.description: A valid email address of the registrant.

country.description: The registrant's country in two-letter abbreviated form.

zip.description: The registrant's zip or postal code.

state.description: The registrant's state or province.

role_in_purchase_process.description: The registrant's role in the purchase process.

comments.description: Any questions or comments from the registrant.

custom_questions.description: Custom questions and answers from the registrant.

actions.description: Create a meeting in Zoom.
actions.name: create-meeting

userId.description: The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.

type.description: Meeting Type: 1 - Instant meeting, 2 - Scheduled meeting, 3 - Recurring meeting with no fixed time, 8 - Recurring meeting with fixed time.

start_time.description: Meeting start time in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ).

duration.description: Meeting duration in minutes. Used for scheduled meetings only.

timezone.description: Time zone to format start_time. For example, "America/Los_Angeles".

password.description: Passcode to join the meeting. Max 10 characters.

id.description: Meeting ID.

actions.name: create-user

actions.description: Create a webinar in Zoom.
actions.name: create-webinar

userId.description: The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass "me". Defaults to "me".

type.description: Webinar type: 5 (Webinar), 6 (Recurring no fixed time), 9 (Recurring fixed time). Defaults to 5.

start_time.description: Webinar start time in ISO 8601 format. Required for type 5 and 9.

actions.description: Delete or archive a meeting registrant in Zoom.
actions.name: delete-meeting-registrant

actions.description: Delete or archive a meeting in Zoom.
actions.name: delete-meeting

meetingId.description: The meeting ID to delete. Example: "123456789"

occurrenceId.description: The meeting occurrence ID for recurring meetings. Example: "abc123"

actions.description: Delete or archive a recording in Zoom.
actions.name: delete-recording

meeting_id.description: The meeting ID or meeting UUID. Example: "123456789"

action.description: The recording delete action. "trash" moves the recording to trash (default), "delete" permanently deletes the recording.

actions.description: Delete or archive a user in Zoom.
actions.name: delete-user

userId.description: The user ID or email address of the user to delete. Example: "user@example.com"

action.description: Delete action: disassociate (default) removes the user from the account; delete permanently removes the user.

transfer_email.description: Email address of the user to transfer meetings, webinars, and recordings to before deletion.

transfer_meeting.description: Whether to transfer meetings to the transfer_email user. Default: true.

transfer_webinar.description: Whether to transfer webinars to the transfer_email user. Default: true.

transfer_recording.description: Whether to transfer cloud recordings to the transfer_email user. Default: true.

userId.description: The ID of the deleted or archived user.

actions.description: Delete or archive a webinar in Zoom.
actions.name: delete-webinar

webinar_id.description: The unique identifier of the webinar to delete. Example: "123456789"

page_size.description: The number of records returned within a single API call. Max 300.

actions.description: List recordings from Zoom.
actions.name: list-recordings

user_id.description: The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass "me" as the value for userId.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Maps to next_page_token.

page_size.description: The number of records returned within a single API call. Max 300.

from.description: The start date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' UTC format.

to.description: The end date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' UTC format.

trash.description: Query trash. true: List recordings from trash.

trash_type.description: The type of Cloud recording to retrieve from the trash.
